quotes.quote: Virginia governor wakes up to fact datacenters have become political cancer

headline: Virginia executive order restrains data center approvals and bans official NDAs
summary: Both reports describe a Virginia executive order that bans executive branch officials from signing nondisclosure agreements, limits data center permitting and calls for stronger environmental protections, giving local communities more say over development. One adds that the order also creates an AI task force. They differ in framing: one describes the measures neutrally, the other casts data centers as a political problem the governor has belatedly recognised.
